body:
Required midterm snapshot, compiled and reviewed before optional extensions.

The graph-context sampler achieved 62.04% balanced useful yield under UMA and 63.45% under matched MACE evaluation, versus 58.62% and 57.29% frozen mutation. Its latent pathway is nearly unused; the supported improvement is conditional spatial autoregressive sampling. The descriptor pilot showed no demonstrated benefit.

This snapshot contains 28 matched 4000-update fits, 34,560 frozen UMA attempts, and a prespecified 20,736-attempt MACE audit. A clean installation replayed all 24 tables byte-for-byte. Protected historical files remain unchanged. No new DFT or MLIP fine-tuning was run.

The ZIP contains fitted CVAE checkpoints, exact inputs, scalar labels, schemas, histories, source metadata, report sources/PDF, and portable replay commands. It contains no foundation-model weights or private conversation PDFs. Raw E/F/stress arrays remain in the HPC archive with audited hashes.

- [Reviewed five-page report plus references](https://github.com/rsilvabuarque/ECE285-1/blob/f4f4db90479f700841fa0b3dde3935ef66ac9036/final_project/docs/midterm1/main.pdf)
- [Portable commands](https://github.com/rsilvabuarque/ECE285-1/blob/f4f4db90479f700841fa0b3dde3935ef66ac9036/final_project/reports/conditioning_20261107/COMMANDS.md)
- [Collaborator tasks](https://github.com/rsilvabuarque/ECE285-1/blob/f4f4db90479f700841fa0b3dde3935ef66ac9036/final_project/docs/COLLABORATOR_TASKS.md)

Required cost is an explicit as-of snapshot with a shared allocation still live. Final accounting and any optional editor/temperature/NEB evidence will be separate receipts; these optional results are absent from this frozen required payload.
